cohort: The study included 26 patients who underwent repeat cerclage due to prolapsed membranes after having a primary cerclage.
finding: NLR at repeat cerclage (RC) was a significant predictor of pregnancy outcome, with a high NLR (>4.7) being associated with worse outcomes, including earlier gestational age at delivery and lower neonatal survival.
gest_age: The average gestational age at primary cerclage was 15.7 weeks, at RC was 21.0 weeks, and delivery outcomes were compared at mean 31.5 weeks vs. 25.9 weeks, with a focus on delivery < 28 weeks.
